eg

>>Psycho Killer = Violent; Animal; Monster
>>Snow Obsessed = Obsessed; Hung Up; Fixated
>>Deviant = Twisted; Weirdo; Crazy
>>Romantic = Romantic; Tender-Hearted; Sweetheart (all used ironically)

OR … might be better to use juicy specific language.  Just so long as Beauty's reaction callbacks feel very pointed -- and it's painfully obvious that she's referring back to your specific interpretations.
